However, their impressive recent form will face its sternest test yet against an opponent that has consistently had their number. Genoa have failed to beat Inter in their last 14 Serie A encounters (D3, L11).

## Team News

Inter will remain without Hakan Calhanoglu and Ange-Yoan Bonny, who are both recovering from thigh injuries. Piotr Zielinski is also a doubt, while Alessandro Bastoni faces a late fitness test after picking up a muscular problem against Stuttgart. [...] As for Genoa, Lorenzo Colombo is facing a lengthy spell on the sidelines after suffering an ACL injury last weekend. Leo Ostigard recently struggled with a high fever but should recover in time to feature, while Morten Frendrup remains a doubt due to an ankle problem.

Osmajic should lead the line once again after his match-winning double against Sassuolo, with Junior Messias and Stephan El Shaarawy expected to provide attacking support.

## Inter vs Genoa Potential Starting Lineups [...] Inter (3-5-2): J. Martinez; Bisseck, Akanji, Carlos Augusto; Spence, Barella, Sucic, Jones, Dimarco; Esposito, L. Martinez.

Genoa (3-4-2-1): Bijlow; Marcandalli, Ostigard, Vasquez; Ehizibue, Frendrup, Traore, Ellertsson; Messias, El Shaarawy; Osmajic.

## Inter vs Genoa Prediction

Inter have been far more convincing at home than on their travels, and their remarkable record against Genoa makes them overwhelming favorites heading into Saturday's encounter.

## Team News

Inter will be missing set-piece specialist Hakan Calhanoglu and back-up striker Ange Bonny due to thigh injuries, while Piotr Zielinski and Alessandro Bastoni are both doubts.

Bastoni was substituted before half time against Stuttgart, and it remains to be seen if he will recover from a muscular problem in time to play. [...] Leo Ostigard was recently hospitalised with a high fever, but he is still expected to lead the visitors' three-man defence in Milan.

Key midfielder Morten Frendrup has been struggling with an ankle issue, meaning he faces a race against time.

Inter Milan possible starting lineup:

J. Martinez; Bisseck, Akanji, Augusto; Spence, Barella, Sucic, Jones, Dimarco; Esposito, L. Martinez

Genoa possible starting lineup: [...] After scoring as a substitute in midweek, Martinez must vie with Marcus Thuram and in-form Esposito to feature up front.

Level with the latter pair in the Capocannoniere race, Genoa striker Osmajic has scored six goals in his first 12 Serie A appearances. The Montenegrin is almost certain to start, as fellow forward Lorenzo Colombo suffered an ACL injury last weekend, probably curtailing his 2026-27 campaign.
